xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3296: bug(cli): pan start flips plan status in the state worktree but never commits it — dirty spec blocks pan task claim and the state reconciler for all agents

plan.title: pan start flips plan status in the state worktree but never commits it — dirty spec blocks pan task claim and the state reconciler
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: pan start (CLI start.ts:1233) and the dashboard start path (spawn.ts:620) flip the canonical spec's plan.status to 'running' via bare updatePlanStatus() — a filesystem write into the shared state worktree with no commit/push. The dirty spec then blocks git rebase in reconcileStatePush (record-update.ts:274), which wedges pan task claim for the work agent and every records push-race reconciliation machine-wide (observed 5 ahead / 21 behind in the PAN-3286 incident).
narratives.Proposal: Collapse the two-step flip into a single committed+pushed transitionXBriefOnMain(..., 'active', 'running') at both call sites, keeping the workspace-draft fallback for pre-promotion plans. Remove the two remaining exported bare-write doors (moveXBriefFilesOnly, deleteXBrief — test-only callers). Teach reconcileStatePush to adopt uncommitted changes confined to specs/ and records/ with a loud 'chore(state): adopt orphaned write' commit instead of wedging, failing closed for unowned paths. Add a cross-door durability test gate asserting git status --porcelain is empty after every exported spec-mutation door. Full design in .pan/drafts/PAN-3296.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No adoption of dirty paths outside specs/ and records/ (continues/, drafts/, operator files stay fail-closed)
- No rebase/replay added to pushStateBranch in auto-commit.ts (PAN-2541 D10 no-replay stance is by design)
- No auto-commit behavior added inside updatePlanStatus itself (double-queue hazard)
- No changes to the PAN-2516 drift patrol cadence or scope
- No fix for PAN-3291 content-conflict wedges beyond the adoption path specified here
- No changes to legacy unmigrated (.pan/) project paths beyond what the shared code paths already cover

autoDecisions.summary: Collapse approve+running two-step into one transitionXBriefOnMain(..., 'active', 'running') committed transition
autoDecisions.rationale: transitionXBriefOnMainPromise already handles move+status+commit+push and fails loudly; planning-time grep found zero consumers of the intermediate plan.status === 'approved', so the end state is identical minus the dirty file.

autoDecisions.summary: Guard at call sites (path startsWith workspace) instead of making updatePlanStatus commit
autoDecisions.rationale: Queueing inside the primitive would double-queue with transitionXBriefOnMainPromise's batch and degrade its explicit commit subjects to generic batch messages.

autoDecisions.summary: Adoption scope limited to specs/ and records/
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the PAN-2516 drift patrol's ownedPaths; wider adoption risks silently committing operator or mid-migration files the door does not own.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete moveXBriefFilesOnly and deleteXBrief rather than adding commit steps
autoDecisions.rationale: Zero production callers (verified by grep); keeping exported bare-write doors invites recurrence of this exact bug class.

autoDecisions.summary: Guard implemented as a durability test gate, not a runtime CLI exit hook
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's fix sketch asks for a guard/test; a test iterating every exported door mechanically blocks future bare-write regressions without adding runtime complexity to CLI shutdown.

items.title: Route the pan start CLI status flip through the state write door

expected_outputs: durability suite passes including the new CLI start-flip case

narrative.Action: In src/cli/commands/start.ts (~lines 1214-1238), replace the transitionXBriefOnMain(projectRoot, id, 'active', 'approved', ...) call plus the bare updatePlanStatus(spawnedPlanPath, 'running') with a single transitionXBriefOnMain(projectRoot, id, 'active', 'running', `chore(state): start ${id.toUpperCase()} xBRIEF (status=running)`). Keep updatePlanStatus(spawnedPlanPath, 'running') only when spawnedPlanPath.startsWith(workspace + sep) (workspace-draft fallback, gitignored). Add a test in the durability suite: temp migrated state worktree with bare origin and a proposed spec → run the flip → plan.status === 'running', porcelain empty, commit on origin/overdeck-state. See PRD WI-1 and decisions D1/D2 in .pan/drafts/PAN-3296.md.

reconcileStatePush adopts orphaned specs/records writes instead of wedging

expected_outputs: new adoption and fail-closed test cases pass

narrative.Action: In reconcileStatePush (src/lib/pan-dir/record-update.ts:274), before EACH rebase attempt in the loop (hazard H3: git refuses rebase on any unstaged tracked change): run git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all via the module's existing git() helper. If dirty and every path (strip 3-char prefix, resolve '->' renames like reconcileStatePlaneDrift does) is under specs/ or records/, run git add -- specs records and git commit -m 'chore(state): adopt orphaned write before state rebase (PAN-3296)' -- specs records, with console.warn('[record-update] adopted orphaned state write(s): <paths>'), then proceed. If any dirty path is outside those dirs, throw an Error naming the offending paths (fail closed). Tests: (a) push-race with a dirty tracked spec → adoption commit created, record mutation lands on origin, porcelain empty; (b) dirty unowned file at worktree root → reconcile throws naming the file. See PRD WI-4, decisions D3/D5, hazards H2/H3.

items.title: Given a push race and an uncommitted change to a tracked spec file, updateIssueRecord creates a commit with subject containing 'adopt orphaned write', completes the rebase, and pushes the record mutation to origin/overdeck-state
After adoption-path reconciliation, git status --porcelain in the state worktree returns empty output
Given a dirty file outside specs/ and records/, reconciliation rejects with an error message naming that path and creates no adoption commit
The adoption path emits a console.warn line listing the adopted paths
Cross-door clean-tree durability gate over every exported spec-mutation door

expected_outputs: gate suite passes: each of the five doors leaves porcelain empty and its commit on origin

narrative.Action: Extend src/lib/pan-dir/__tests__/state-door-durability.test.ts with a suite iterating the five exported spec-mutation doors — writeSpecForIssue, updateSpecStatus, writeSpecDocument, transitionXBriefOnMain, moveXBrief — each run against a temp MIGRATED state worktree with a bare origin (hazard H1: reuse the file's existing harness). After each door call, assert git status --porcelain is empty and the commit exists on the origin ref. This is the mechanical 'no bare writes left behind' guard from the issue's fix sketch; a future bare-write door added to the list fails the gate. No fake timers — real git subprocesses, no retry delays (hazard H4). See PRD WI-5.

items.title: For each of the five exported doors, the gate suite runs the door and the subsequent git status --porcelain invocation returns empty output in the state worktree
Each door's commit is resolvable on the bare origin's overdeck-state ref after the call returns
